summary: BUG-156: Dashboard Partners "Supply by product" shows Excursion 4 / Transfer 2 and no Flight - there are 5 / 3 / 1 approved suppliers
description:
Module: Insights > Dashboard | Tab: Partners | Type: Wrong data | Severity: Medium
Steps to reproduce:
1. Dashboard > Partners, widget "Supply by product".
2. Compare with Supplier list (Approved suppliers and the service types each offers).
Actual result: Accommodation 8, Excursion 4, Transfer 2 - no Flight line.
Expected result (product owner, 24 Nov 2026: the number of APPROVED suppliers per product):
- Accommodation 8: Amrat Testing Partner, Amrat Choudhary, Corniche Grand Hotel, Desert Rose Resort & Spa, Marina Bay Hotel, The Connaught Residency, Sahil Holidays, Ace Travels (correct)
- Excursion 5: Amrat Testing Partner, Amrat Choudhary, Arabian Nights Tours, Sahil Holidays, Ace Travels (shown 4)
- Transfer 3: Amrat Testing Partner, Amrat Choudhary, Desert Line Transfers (shown 2)
- Flight 1: Sahil Holidays (not shown)
Environment: STAGE https://erp.nexgenpilot.com (company sb, Chrome), build of 24 Nov 2026 | Bug report ID: BUG-156

summary: BUG-157: Dashboard Allotments leaves out ACTIVE allotments that have no room linked - Ace Travels "10/26 - 10/27 Allotments" and "Full Allotment" (1,000 units each)
description:
Module: Insights > Dashboard | Tab: Allotments | Type: Wrong data | Severity: Medium
Steps to reproduce:
1. Dashboard > Allotments, "Utilisation, next 30 days" and "Utilisation by hotel and room".
2. Compare with the allotments of supplier Ace Travels (Approved): "10/26 - 10/27 Allotments" (Hotel, 24 Oct 2026 - 23 Oct 2027, 1,000 units, 1 consumed, active) and "Full Allotment" (24 Oct 2026 - 23 Oct 2027, 1,000 units, active) - neither has a room / product linked.
Actual result: both are missing from "Utilisation by hotel and room" and from the total "0 of 1,140 room-nights sold" (1,140 = only the 7 allotments with a room).
Expected result: active allotments are counted in Utilisation even without a room linked (product owner, 24 Nov 2026).
Environment: STAGE https://erp.nexgenpilot.com (company sb, Chrome), build of 24 Nov 2026 | Bug report ID: BUG-157

summary: BUG-158: Cancelling a reservation does not give the rooms back to the allotment - Marina Bay "Deluxe Room Marina View" shows 19 consumed, 15 of them from cancelled bookings
description:
Module: Reservation (cancellation) / Supplier allotment | Type: Business rule | Severity: High
Steps to reproduce:
1. Supplier Marina Bay Hotel > Products > Hotel > Allotment: "Marina Bay Hotel – Deluxe Room Marina View" shows "19 of 2976 · 1%" consumed.
2. Compare with the reservations on that room: 000002 (20-24 Nov 2026, Pending) = 4 room-nights; 000004, 000005, 000006, 000007, 000008 (19-22 Jan 2027, 3 nights each) = 15 room-nights - all five are CANCELLED.
Actual result: 19 consumed = 4 + 15 - the cancelled bookings still use the allotment, so 15 room-nights in January cannot be sold again.
Expected result: cancelling a reservation releases its rooms back to the allotment (product owner, 24 Nov 2026) - consumed should be 4.
Environment: STAGE https://erp.nexgenpilot.com (company sb, Chrome), build of 24 Nov 2026 | Bug report ID: BUG-158 | found while validating the Dashboard (Allotments)

summary: Suggestion: Dashboard Allotments - show WHICH bookings / quotes hold the rooms behind "Active holds"
description:
Suggestion (product owner, 24 Nov 2026) - not a bug.
Module: Insights > Dashboard | Tab: Allotments
Today the Dashboard shows "Active holds 8 - Rooms held, not yet released" and "Holds by source: BackOffice 5, AgentPortal 3", but no screen lists the holds themselves, so the numbers cannot be checked against bookings (e.g. whether the 3 AgentPortal holds belong to agent-portal checkouts that were never paid).
Suggestion: make "Active holds" open a list of the holds - room, dates, rooms held, source (back office / agent portal), the reservation or checkout it belongs to, when it was made and when it is released.
